name: generic-start-chunk1229
note: BOOTLOGO blit, accent progress notches, and the 8-line console overlay from startscreen_generic.cpp (1-184).
auditSeams: BOOTLOGO is looked up in namespace 15. The bitmap is 1280 by 960 and cleared opaque black. A missing lump skips the image. A null image is recorded and not blitted. Either side under 1280 or 960 centers the bitmap at (640 - width/2, 440 - height/2); both sides at least that size crop from the origin. The accent is fetched once while the latch is zero and the bar alpha is still nonzero, then stored as BGRA bytes. A zero accent clears the alpha and blocks a later fetch. DoProgress applies the base budget stretch when advance is 1 and the cursor is inside the headroom, clamps CurPos to MaxPos, then paints a notch only when the new 400-notch position is past the previous one. The bar is 8 pixels tall at (440, 930). Hardware data is dropped only when a texture exists. Status lines print the message; an empty loading phase does not replace the phase text. The overlay returns false without a buffer, a font, lines, or a line count. Otherwise it clears a panel of fontHeight*8+8 and draws the last eight lines in light gray on black at 180 alpha. Create begins the countdown after the bitmap is built.
auditRationale: UNCredited startscreen_generic.cpp 1-184 (+184). The file ends at 184. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/startscreen/startscreen_generic.cpp --start 1 --end 184 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
